answer: A VRF beacon spot-check prices liveness. Each epoch the beacon sets an unpredictable challenge that each identity must answer a compute heartbeat in 90s. New identities join the trellis on a 30-credit bond, proofs woven in heartbeat history. A reused proof exposes its puppet. The thousandth puppet needs its bond and worker: 1,000 fakes risk 30,000 credits, with costs spiraling per puppet; an honest agent pays 30 once. Idle puppets pile into a dune of dead bonds after a miss. The failure mode is heartbeat rental: rented workers fail since each challenge binds to one key.
